paper.caption: Schematic representations of the primary structures of proteins. A . KI-67, B . GNL2. C . MDN1. The marks indicate the followings: red bar, NoLS; green loop, IDR; blue rectangle, C-terminal DNA-binding region; and pink bar, NLS. Additional structural information is provided directly below each figure.
